items.title: Waldren "Frog" Joseph Interview, 1961-07-10
items.q: INTERVIEWER: Did you ever get to hear Ur's in person? INTERVIEWEE: Never did. Never did see him.

ctx.x: Well I don't have too many of them. About two or three of them. And I got the other two I have in mind I don't have no title for them. Mm-hmm. Now Paul and I got to get on the slide for a slide because when I got with them at the Mardi Gras a lot of people used to ask for
Ur's trombone. Oh yeah. Ur's Creole trombone.

Well you know out there on the street I mean take a tune like Ur's Creole trombone. Well I mean you got to feel them things you know. Yeah just start to know trick things that he does. Yeah well I mean he can do more justice with it than uh than anyone else. Well you didn't have no time to rehearsal. And you know the man don't want no music sitting up there. Yeah. So we got together and said well we're going to get the tune. So we Paul had a pretty good idea on regs. Mm-hmm. So we got together and well I feel…
